headline: One picture, 3 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 3 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 3 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.006 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): b840525e4a0e on 2 works, 7494033a6cc2 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Recharge Pit (3).
All 3 works report the same GPS point (25.262175, 82.739867).
The picture was uploaded 3 times within 18 minutes (2025-10-04 10:33:48 to 2025-10-04 10:51:24).
